title: End User Computing Engineer
summary: An end user computing (EUC) engineer designs and runs the desktops, laptops and virtual desktops that staff use every day, using tools such as Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop, Intune and SCCM. You sit in the infrastructure team above the service desk, building images, packaging apps and fixing problems the desk cannot solve.
dailyDuties: Build and update golden images for laptops and virtual desktops
Package and deploy applications through Intune or SCCM
Fix Citrix or AVD login, profile and performance issues
Push Windows updates and compliance policies to devices
Resolve L2/L3 tickets escalated from the service desk
Script routine fixes and reports in PowerShell
Plan and test changes before monthly patch windows

skills.expectation: Build and support Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop or Horizon desktops and published apps
Deploy apps, policies and updates to laptops with Intune or SCCM
Package and test applications as MSI, MSIX or Intune Win32 apps
Manage Group Policy and the Windows servers behind the desktop estate
Manage users, groups and access in Active Directory
Script desktop builds, fixes and reports in PowerShell
Resolve L2/L3 incidents and run changes through ITIL processes
Take escalations from the service desk and fix root causes on Windows devices
Join devices to Entra ID and set conditional access
Support Outlook, Teams and OneDrive on user devices
Run the hypervisor hosts that carry VDI workloads
Host Azure Virtual Desktop and session hosts on Azure
Roll out Defender or other endpoint protection policies
Trace DNS, VPN and network issues on user sessions

certifications.why: Base for Azure Virtual Desktop work
Covers Entra ID device and access policies
Intune and Autopilot are core EUC skills, and EUC postings name this certification.
For EUC roles that run Azure Virtual Desktop.
Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops is common in Indian EUC and BFSI roles.
